ideas.pitch: Acoustic sensor network running on edge devices to instantly detect gunshots, classify weapon caliber using ML, and stream precise coordinates to tactical maps for rapid civilian evacuation and defense response.
ideas.title: AegisAudio: Edge Gunshot Triangulation and Threat Classification
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets national security and defense technologies under the Blueprint for Peace theme, mirroring the architecture of proven acoustic detection systems while adding edge computing for field reliability.

ideas.pitch: Low-bandwidth CCTV stream analyzer that performs localized face embeddings matching against encrypted watchlists, instantly alerting local security posts with automated snapshot emails and live tracking.
ideas.title: SentinelCCTV: Real-Time Wanted Criminal and Missing Person Face Surveillance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent public safety challenge using computer vision, following a proven runner-up architecture tailored for civilian protection and border security.

ideas.pitch: Post-disaster reconstruction transparency platform where every relief supply request and fund allocation carries a cryptographic seal, ensuring zero leakage and verifiable public accountability in rebuilding nations.
ideas.title: ResQMap: Cryptographically Sealed Humanitarian Aid and Resource Tracking
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the 'Rebuilding Nations' track by offering verifiable public accountability for post-war or post-disaster reconstruction funds, combining security with high social impact.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile application utilizing ambient Wi-Fi and Bluetooth signal strength profiling to map multi-story indoor locations, guiding rescue workers safely through smoke-filled or compromised structures.
ideas.title: BeaconFloor: Indoor RF Localization for First Responders in Hostile Environments
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly solves the life-safety navigation problem for defense personnel and emergency responders operating in unfamiliar or damaged infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: Secure, self-destructing communication platform for field operatives and civilian protection agencies to transmit sensitive coordinates and intelligence without leaving server-side footprints.
ideas.title: GhostDispatch: Zero-Knowledge Sensitive Intelligence Drop
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses cyber defence and secure military communications by combining ephemeral data transport with legal-grade cryptographic shredding.
